provenance.title: Clear space around furniture
provenance.covers: How much free space is wanted between pieces, around a door that swings in, and how far a socket needs to stay uncovered. Written from general knowledge in our own words.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
Approved Document P: Electrical safety, dwellings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. Pieces that stand apart should leave at least this much to walk between them. Touching is allowed.

then.swing: square as wide as the door

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. A door that opens into the room keeps a free square as wide as the door.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. Step used when looking for a free spot. The second choice is at least this far from the first.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. How much bigger to make a room that cannot hold its furniture. Touch: how near a wall counts as against it.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. A tall piece may not cover a socket or stand closer to it than this.
